Origin and meaning

The name Emily has Latin roots and means “rival, eager”.

About the name Emily

A Latin-rooted classic shared by the poet Emily Dickinson.

As a gift or a tattoo

People often order Emily as a framed gift or as a tattoo — the meaning, “rival, eager”, is part of the appeal.
